scope: Read-only selected public hardware, service status and power settings; no database connection or system-setting changes

hardware.command: Get-CimInstance Win32_Processor | Select-Object Name,NumberOfCores,NumberOfLogicalProcessors | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem | Select-Object Caption,Version,TotalVisibleMemorySize,FreePhysicalMemory | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; Get-CimInstance Win32_LogicalDisk -Filter "DeviceID='C:'" | Select-Object DeviceID,Size,FreeSpace | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; Get-Service -Name '*postgres*' | Select-Object Name,Status | ConvertTo-Json -Compress

power.command: powercfg /getactivescheme; powercfg /query SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_SLEEP STANDBYIDLE; powercfg /query SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_SLEEP HIBERNATEIDLE; powercfg /qh SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_BUTTONS
